name: store
purpose: Owner-scoped document store and the classified data declaration
usedFor: Any app that keeps records about people and must be able to hand a person their whole record or erase it. Declare every collection once with `field(name, type, class)`; draw it with `erd()`; check it with `unclassified()`.
notFor: Shared reference data with no owner (give it a system owner, as the operator does with `_operator`), append-only logs (use the evidence block or a ledger), or facts that must be encrypted at rest (seal them with the runtime block's sealed store).
